- **Candidate 1** orders both products every 2 days with about 10% safety stock. It never comes close to the warehouse limit, so it handles demand swings well.
- **Candidate 4** pays the same ordering costs as candidate 1 but orders product 1 only every 4 days. That means more holding cost and more pressure on warehouse space.
